name: Rebrandly
description:
Rebrandly is a link management platform for creating short links on your own branded domain and measuring what happens after the click.

The Rebrandly connector brings that into Claude. Once connected, you can:

- Create, update, find and delete branded short links, including custom slugs, titles and destination URLs
- Pull click analytics for a link or a set of links, and ask questions about performance across workspaces
- Organise links with tags and other attributes
- Work across the workspaces and branded domains you already have in Rebrandly
- Check account and workspace details, including which domains are available to you

Typical uses: create a batch of campaign links from a brief, ask which links drove the most clicks last month, retarget a link whose destination changed, or audit a set of old links before a site migration.

You connect by signing in with your Rebrandly account. 
A Rebrandly account is required. 
Creating links on a branded domain requires a domain already configured in Rebrandly.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Rebrandly to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Rebrandly to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.rebrandly.com/v1/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Rebrandly MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Rebrandly lists 36 MCP tools, including rebrandly_attach_domain_to_workspace, rebrandly_attach_script_to_link, rebrandly_attach_tag_to_link, rebrandly_count_attributes, rebrandly_count_links, rebrandly_create_attribute, rebrandly_create_link, rebrandly_create_link_rule, rebrandly_create_script, rebrandly_create_workspace, rebrandly_delete_attribute, and rebrandly_delete_link.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Rebrandly?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Rebrandly in marketing-seo on the Manufact MCP catalog include Buzzfy, Airefs AI Visibility, TalkGenAI, RankControl, and attentive-mcp-server.
Rebrandly requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Rebrandly is developed by Rebrandly. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
